faq.question: What does 1000W mean for ATHENA?
faq.answer: Most average diode lasers operate around 600W - these are entry/mid category. 1000W is already a level higher: faster work, greater efficiency, more stable operation. More than enough for professional-level work.

faq.question: What can the smart software do?
faq.answer: It recognizes the skin and hair type and automatically optimizes the treatment parameters. You don't have to determine which setting to use - ATHENA helps. It's like an expert standing next to you.

faq.question: Who is ATHENA recommended for?
faq.answer: For beauticians who want to incorporate it alongside another service (as a complement to skincare). For safety players who are looking for a predictable, stable system. For new entrants who want a cost-efficient, smart investment.

faq.question: What is the difference between ATHENA, OLYMPIA, HELIOS and EMPIRE 4WAVE?
faq.answer: All four of our diode lasers combine the same four wavelengths (755 / 808 / 940 / 1064 nm) in one handpiece; the difference is in speed and intelligence: ATHENA (1000W) - precision, control, cost-efficient entry. OLYMPIA (1200W) - the smart choice, value-for-money champion. HELIOS (1600W) - top tier, maximum performance. EMPIRE 4WAVE (1200W) - AI micro-camera diagnostics, Android interface and digital client records.

faq.question: How quickly does it pay off?
faq.answer: An illustrative example: with a treatment fee of 12,000 Ft, a cost of 2,000 Ft per treatment and about 3-4 clients per working day, 60 treatments a month leave a contribution margin of about 600,000 Ft. On that basis the device can pay for itself in about 3.3 months and generate about 12.4 M Ft net contribution over 24 months. This is an illustrative calculation, not a financial promise - ask for a personalised calculation!

faq.question: What is included in the price?
faq.answer: The price includes comprehensive operator training, FAR certificate, 2-year warranty and the Hungarian-language user manual. Delivery time is 2-6 weeks. For an exact price, request a consultation.

faq.question: How many sessions are needed for a lasting result?
faq.answer: The number of sessions varies from client to client: hair and skin type, the treated area and the hair growth cycle all affect it. The laser acts on follicles in the active growth phase, so several sessions are needed for every follicle to be reached. Where excess hair growth has a hormonal cause, occasional maintenance sessions may be needed later – worth setting this out with clients in advance, as it is the most common source of misunderstanding.

faq.question: What power supply does the ATHENA need?
faq.answer: The device runs on both 110V and 220V, so it connects to a standard salon supply. We go through installation and connection together during the on-site handover and training.

faq.question: What makes the sapphire contact-cooled handpiece more comfortable?
faq.answer: A real sapphire crystal in the handpiece cools the skin surface directly during treatment, backed by three-stage cooling: TEC semiconductor, water and air. This reduces the sensation of heat for the client, makes energy delivery more even, and keeps the device stable through longer treatment series – fewer forced breaks, faster work.

faq.question: Can I buy the ATHENA in instalments?
faq.answer: Yes. You pay a 50% deposit at purchase and can spread the remaining amount over 3 or 6 months – these two terms are available for devices priced between 1 and 3 million forints. If you buy several devices at once, a longer term may also be possible. You can calculate the exact deposit and monthly instalment with the calculator on the product page.

faq.question: How long until the device arrives, and when can I start working with it?
faq.answer: Expected delivery time is 2–6 weeks. Operator training is included in the price of the device and is tied to the handover: after the one-day intensive course we issue a FAR certificate. Training is therefore part of the process, not a separate step you have to arrange.

faq.question: What happens if the device breaks down?
faq.answer: Repairs are carried out by our own workshop in Hungary, using original parts – no weeks of waiting for a service centre abroad. The device comes with a full 2-year warranty. If the initial assessment shows the repair is likely to take more than 10 working days, we provide a replacement device for the duration of the repair, subject to availability, so your work does not stop.

faq.question: Can it be used on every skin type?
faq.answer: The ATHENA works at four wavelengths (755 / 808 / 940 / 1064 nm), and their combination allows follicles at different depths, as well as lighter and darker skin types, to be treated. Which setting is right for a given client – and when not to treat at all – is covered in detail during operator training: contraindications and client selection are part of the course syllabus.
